title: Ball & Chain founder Hideaki Mihara visits Manila to meet PH fans
summary: Japanese designer Hideaki Mihara, founder and creative director of Ball & Chain, visited Manila on Nov. 25, meeting local fans, collectors and customers at the brand's store at The Podium.
